self.title: Thought Space Explorer framework methodology empirical limitations in epistemic self-correction

detail.reason: The TSE framework currently serves as a primary model for navigating blind spots; we need to clarify its limitations regarding true self-correction versus heuristic search expansion to meet notebook synthesis standards.

detail.title: LLM Reasoning Blind Spot Identification
detail.question: To what extent can Large Language Models systematically identify and navigate 'blind spots' in their own generated thought structures?
detail.reason: Previous experiment resulted in invalid measurement; protocol refinement required.

children.title: Cycle 5 · Advancing Intelligent Disobedience and Reasoning Blind Spot Frameworks

detail.title: Advancing Intelligent Disobedience and Reasoning Blind Spot Frameworks
detail.summary: This cycle progresses the research into intelligent disobedience in shared autonomy and LLM reasoning blind spots. We are actively expanding the evidentiary base for intelligent disobedience beyond the current single-source limitation, and initiating deeper technical analysis into the Thought Space Explorer (TSE) framework to evaluate its efficacy in navigating epistemic blind spots.
